text: Entry2128 adds style-src chrome: unsafe-inline to sendProgress.xhtml, whose existing markup has inline minimum sizes, flex alignment and progress sizing. The selected fixed source retains that permission. Existing default-src and script-src were not changed in this landing; later moz-src script permission is separate comparison context. This is a scoped compatibility exception for existing privileged dialog markup, not a general recommendation to relax CSP. The bug reports Daily verification but no automated coverage. No CSP console, visual, keyboard or send test ran here.
title: Send-progress CSP permits the inline styles used by that dialog
